home.description: Turn everyday appreciation into visible employee strengths and actionable culture insights. GETH combines physical recognition cards with personal dashboards and organisational insights, helping employees feel valued and companies understand what makes their people thrive.
home.deckPreviewTitle: See how recognition comes to life.
home.deckPreviewCopy: Preview a few cards from our impact categories.
home.previewListeningCopy: You give people space to speak openly, without judgment. Your attention makes the difference.
home.previewRenewingCopy: You bring fresh ideas and new perspectives that help others grow and see new possibilities.
home.previewGoalOrientedCopy: You set clear goals, make plans, and bring them to life step by step.
home.previewCaringCopy: You pay attention to colleagues and contribute to a positive, safe, and engaged work environment.
home.howCopy: Recognition becomes visible in five simple steps.
home.step1Copy: Choose a card that fits what you want to express.
home.step2Copy: Give the card to someone and share why this matters to you.
home.step3Title: The receiver scans the QR code
home.step3Copy: The receiver scans the QR code to record the compliment digitally and grow their profile.
home.step4Copy: Appreciation becomes visible in the personal profile and in the team overview.
home.step5Copy: More appreciation creates more connection, energy and growth.
home.companiesCopy: Build a culture of recognition that drives engagement, retention, and measurable impact.
home.managersCopy: Spot what matters, celebrate often, and lead with data that helps your team thrive.
home.employeesCopy: Feel valued, energized, and connected through everyday recognition.

footer.title: Bridging physical recognition with digital culture intelligence.
footer.copy: GETH helps companies turn meaningful appreciation into visible insight across employees, managers, and entire organizations.

visionPage.metaDescription: The vision, mission, and meaning behind GETH.
visionPage.title: GETH Vision, Mission & Meaning
visionPage.visionCopy: GETH envisions a world of work where recognition is visible, measurable, and embedded in everyday interactions. A world where colleagues recognise each other in the moment, personally and tangibly, enabling people, teams, and culture to grow stronger together.
visionPage.missionCopyBefore: GETH helps organisations make recognition visible and measurable. Through
visionPage.missionCopyAfter: across four pillars, colleagues recognise each other personally and in the moment. In doing so, GETH strengthens connection, engagement, and performance in everyday work.
visionPage.meaningBelief: We believe organisations thrive when people feel seen, valued, and recognised for the contributions they make every day.
